idh1-r132h-glioma.text: IDH1 p.Arg132His (R132H) produces neomorphic enzyme activity and accumulation of D-2-hydroxyglutarate. This alteration is associated with IDH-mutant diffuse gliomas and should be interpreted with the histologic and molecular findings.

braf-v600e-melanoma.text: BRAF p.Val600Glu (V600E) is an activating kinase-domain substitution that promotes MAPK signaling. This alteration occurs in melanoma; its clinical implications depend on the tumor type and treatment setting.
